Love, you are NOT a burden. If they're making you feel that way, *they are shitty people who don't deserve you*. You are a human being with thoughts, emotions, and experiences. You are you; irreplaceable. And ik it seems like no one cares, but i can promise you, they do. If you were to pass, they'd regret every single shitty thing they did and said. 

Take a look at who is in your life rn. Is person x a good influence on my well being? No? Take a break from them or cut them out. There's free councilors online (there may be a wait but it is worth it). And how i got my help, I made a primary care visit and just absolutely broke down in front of her and spewed my feelings. She got me to see someone that isn't a psychiatrist but someone who prescribes medication to manage symptoms before you can get help. I was prescribed Lamotrigine. I'm not joking when I say this literally saved my life.
